description: Submitting a DIFFERENT result payload for an attempt that already has an accepted result must be rejected as a conflict, not silently accepted and not silently discarded.
notes: KNOWN GAP, not yet backend-executable: the Backend's actual current behavior for this exact sequence is NOT to reject - VersusSeries.CompleteAttempt checks only 'is the existing attempt already Completed?' and, if so, returns it unchanged with no comparison against the newly-submitted payload and no error (see Level5.Domain.Tests.Competition.VersusSeriesTests.CompleteAttempt_twice_is_idempotent_and_keeps_the_original_result, which submits 50 then 999 and asserts BOTH calls return 50 with no exception). That test proves the Backend cannot currently distinguish this fixture from fixture 10 (identical-result-retry) - both take the same code path and both silently keep the first value. Unity's Attempt.Complete DOES distinguish by rejecting outright ('a completed attempt cannot be resubmitted', VersusSeriesCorrespondenceTests.SubmittingTheSameFinishedTurnTwiceIsRefused), but it also does not special-case 'was the resubmission identical' - it just always throws, which would also incorrectly reject fixture 10 if driven through the domain a second time. Required for #11: CompleteAttempt must compare the incoming result to the stored one *before* returning early - identical payload -> fixture 10's idempotent-success path; different payload -> this fixture's conflict-rejected path (HTTP 409, not a silent 200).
